newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto-Dominion names Baillie as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Toronto-Dominion names Baillie as CEO.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Thursday that Charles Baillie will become president and chief executive officer of Canada's fifth-largest bank early next year.
Baillie, who is currently president of the bank, will replace current chief executive Richard Thomson effective February 1, 1997.
T-D Bank said in a statement that Thomson will continue as chairman until he retires January 31, 1998. The bank said Baillie will then take over as chairman effective February 1, 1998.
The board also announced that effective February 1, 1997, William T. Brock will become deputy chairman and report to the president and chief executive officer.
